Her clearly visible face and long center-parted dark wavy hair follow only the supplied portrait's visible facial and hair appearance; show her determined expression in sharp focus. At that same impact, the black flood behind the serpent is already dividing into four straight shining rivers, while concentric stone terraces rise above the receding water and a level horizon opens between earth and sky. Use a medium-wide low viewpoint that keeps her face, both hands on the spear, the contacted serpent, and the ordered terrain consequence simultaneously legible. Render wet bronze, rain-dark scales, salt spray, and physically coherent storm light with documentary texture.
